doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07

title: Piano players in New Orleans when Billie arrived
summary: They discuss Williamena Bartlett, Jeanette, Edna Francis and Walter Decou, who played ragtime, blues and Spanish pieces.
